title: #131 Assessment Systems
prompt: There are different assessment systems, putting all exams at the end of the term, or assignments and exams being spread out throughout the semester. What are the advantages and disadvantages of each system? Which system do you prefer?

promptSegments.text: There are different assessment systems, putting all exams at the end of the term, or assignments and exams being spread out throughout the semester.
What are the advantages and disadvantages of each system?

requirements.en: Discuss the important advantages and disadvantages.
requirements.vi: Thảo luận những ưu điểm và nhược điểm quan trọng.
Đưa ra nhận định tổng thể theo yêu cầu.

requirements.en: Support the comparison with relevant examples.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ phần so sánh bằng ví dụ phù hợp.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first system (end-of-term tests) allows students to focus on learning for a long time, which is good for planning.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first system (end-of-term tests) allows students to focus on learning for a long time, which is good for planning.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The second system (spread-out tests) helps students keep their knowledge fresh because they get chances to show what they know often.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The second system (spread-out tests) helps students keep their knowledge fresh because they get chances to show what they know often.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first body paragraph argues that spreading out tests and homework is better because it reduces stress and helps continuous learning.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first body paragraph argues that spreading out tests and homework is better because it reduces stress and helps continuous learning.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The second body paragraph argues that end-of-term tests are bad because students forget material learned at the start of the term.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The second body paragraph argues that end-of-term tests are bad because students forget material learned at the start of the term.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Having exams at the end of a term allows students to focus all their study time on a final assessment, giving them a clear goal and helping them manage their study time effectively.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Having exams at the end of a term allows students to focus all their study time on a final assessment, giving them a clear goal and helping them manage their study time effectively.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Spreading out assessments throughout the semester is beneficial because constant, small tests help students remember information better, improving long-term memory.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Spreading out assessments throughout the semester is beneficial because constant, small tests help students remember information better, improving long-term memory.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Spreading out tests and assignments over time is beneficial because it allows students to practice skills gradually, reducing pre-exam pressure and improving overall learning.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Spreading out tests and assignments over time is beneficial because it allows students to practice skills gradually, reducing pre-exam pressure and improving overall learning.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Conversely, having one large exam at the end of the term is disadvantageous because students only retain information they cram right before the test, leading to stress and poor long-term memory.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Conversely, having one large exam at the end of the term is disadvantageous because students only retain information they cram right before the test, leading to stress and poor long-term memory.

promptTraps.en: Do not answer only the first question while neglecting the second requirement; address both dimensions equally.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ trả lời câu hỏi đầu tiên mà bỏ quên yêu cầu thứ hai; cần giải quyết cả hai khía cạnh công bằng.

promptTraps.en: Do not simply enumerate pros and cons without providing the required evaluation of which side outweighs.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ liệt kê ưu nhược điểm mà quên so sánh và đánh giá mặt nào chiếm ưu thế hơn.

faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
